newsitem.title: FRANCE: Ajaccio air cargo traffic up 10.6 pct Jan-Aug.
newsitem.headline: Ajaccio air cargo traffic up 10.6 pct Jan-Aug.

text.p: Ajaccio's Campo dell'Oro airport said it handled 2,676 tonnes of airfreight in the first eight months of 1996, an increase of 10.6 percent on the same period last year.
The principal airline operator at Ajaccio airport is Air France Europe, which offers daily passenger services from Paris using Airbus 320 series aircraft.

The southern Corsican city is also served by French airline, Air Littoral, which operates an all-cargo charter service on behalf of French parcel delivery groups, Calberson and Sernam, using one of its five-tonne capacity HS748 aircraft.
The HS748 operates a nightly service between Marseille/Bastia/Ajaccio/Marseille.

French carrier, L'Aeropostale, operates nightly Paris-CDG/Marseille-Ajaccio-Marseille-Paris/CDG rotations carrying documents and parcel shipments on behalf of express operator, TAT Express and also postal freight using Boeing 737QC (quick change) aircraft.
January-August 1996 postal traffic handled at Ajaccio airport totalled 2,504 tonnes, up 24.9 percent on 1995 levels, the airport authority said.

Ajaccio's double-digit growth in freight and mail shipments on 1995 levels was largely a result of strikes last year which had a negative impact on airport activity, an airport authority official told Reuters. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
